contact_info.improvement: Add an email, phone number, and LinkedIn profile to ensure recruiters can contact you.

summary.improvement: Add a 'Summary' section at the top of your resume.

technical_skills.improvement: Add more modern frameworks and programming languages.

experience.improvement: Use the STAR method (Situation, Task, Action, Result) to expand your bullet points.

projects.reason: Project section is light or missing.

education.improvement: Add an Education section listing your degrees.

achievements.improvement: Quantify your impact using numbers, percentages, and timeframes (e.g., 'reduced latency by 40%').

action_verbs.improvement: Replace weak verbs (like 'helped' or 'worked on') with strong verbs (like 'spearheaded' or 'architected').

formatting_grammar.reason: Layout lacks standard bullet points or has grammar errors.

external_links.reason: No GitHub or Portfolio links detected.

keyword_density.reason: High keyword density relative to word count.

resume_length.improvement: Aim for a sweet spot of 400-700 words (usually 1-2 pages).

suggestions: Add a professional Summary section — a 3–5 sentence pitch highlighting your key strengths, years of experience, and career goals.
Expand your Experience section with quantified achievements (e.g. 'Reduced API latency by 35 %', 'Led a team of 6 engineers'). Numbers make bullet points 40 % more impactful.
Add more technical skills — only 6 detected. ATS systems scan for keywords; aim for 12–20 relevant skills in a dedicated Skills section.
Add an Education section with your degree, institution, major, and graduation year.
Add a Projects section to showcase hands-on work — include the tech stack and a one-line description of each project.
Add relevant Certifications (e.g. AWS Solutions Architect, Google Cloud, PMP, Kubernetes) to significantly boost recruiter confidence.
Your resume is too brief (48 words). Aim for 400–600 words for entry-level positions or 600–900 words for senior roles.
Ensure your contact information is complete: professional email address, phone number, and your LinkedIn profile URL.
